content.comment_body: Good morning all, Is it possible to use a four-wire or six-wire load cell with [product_name]? Can [product_name] be utilized to measure weight via a load cell, and can outputs be activated when a specific weight is reached? I would appreciate your feedback.
Hello [user_name], I believe it is feasible. The weight sensor would need to be compatible with [product_name] (e.g., provide a 0-10 volt signal). You can find example applications at [url].
I did not find an exact answer to this particular question at the provided link, but hopefully you'll find a solution. Please update us if it works.

Hello [user_name], The 0–10 V DC analog inputs on [product_name] or its AM2 expansion module cannot connect directly to a load cell. The device samples and digitizes input signals, providing 10-bit resolution (0–1000 value). Only voltage changes greater than 0.01 V (10 mV) are detected, so very small load cell signals won't be recognized due to insufficient resolution. Load cells typically use a Wheatstone Bridge configuration and require stable temperature for accurate measurement, along with signal amplification. [product_name] does not have a built-in load cell module for this. You may need an external load cell module that balances the bridge and outputs an amplified signal (e.g., 0–10 V, 0–20 mA, or 4–20 mA) proportional to weight. This signal can then be processed by [product_name] or AM2 for scaling and display. Hope this explanation is helpful!
A new question from [user_name] about program examples for load cells has been moved to a separate thread. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are discussing whether [product_name]'s analog inputs can connect directly to load cells to measure weight and control outputs. There is uncertainty regarding the device's analog input resolution and its ability to detect low millivolt signals from load cells without additional amplification hardware. The lack of a dedicated load cell input module and limited analog input sensitivity restrict direct compatibility with typical load cells.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to connect load cells directly to [product_name] for weight measurement, accurately interpret signals from the load cells, and automatically activate outputs when target weights are achieved.
